description: Portable Coding Bible organization rulebook. Runtime validation remains authoritative.

$schema.description: Editor schema URI. Generated rulebooks point at Coding Bible's published schema.

formatVersion.description: Version of the portable Coding Bible custom-rulebook contract.

name.description: Stable human-readable rulebook name for this team/policy set.

confidence.description: How strongly static evidence supports the finding. Use contextual when project/runtime context can change the conclusion.

contextNote.description: What a human or agent must verify before treating a context-sensitive finding as a violation.

id.description: Organization rule ID in PREFIX-000 form, for example ACME-001.

impact.description: Expected engineering impact when the finding is valid.

languages.description: Optional source-language restriction. Omit to use analyzer defaults.

mode.description: Exact module match by default; prefix protects a module subtree.

source.description: Static import/re-export module source to match.

callee.description: Literal callee expression to match, for example fetch or window.fetch.

message.description: Finding message shown when the matcher fires.

rationale.description: Why the organization enforces this engineering policy.

suggestion.description: Preferred remediation guidance for humans and AI agents.

url.description: Optional HTTPS documentation URL for this organization rule.

title: Coding Bible custom rulebook
